flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:9927 then Log in with email {{global.email}} and password {{secrets.user.password}}.
Open the recipe named Jollof Rice.
Then report three things: the servings or yield shown, how many ingredients are listed, and whether the recipe photo shows a real picture (a plain orange image) or a missing or broken image placeholder.
Get the servings or yield shown for the Jollof Rice recipe and save it as {{servings_yield}}.
Get the number of ingredients listed for the Jollof Rice recipe and save it as {{ingredient_count}}.
Get whether the Jollof Rice recipe photo shows a real picture (a plain orange image) or a missing or broken image placeholder and save it as {{recipe_photo_status}}.
